title: Measuring False Positive Rates of Jailbreak Detectors on Medical and Legal Edge-Case Prompts

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Clear chain: high false-positive rates represent a different kind of safety failure (over-refusal). Quantifying the false-positive tradeoff across detectors is essential for informed deployment. Directly actionable for deployers choosing detectors.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Building a prompt set from CARES benchmark and StrongReject is straightforward. Running prompts through 3-4 publicly available detectors is simple inference. Measuring false-positive rates is basic statistics. Very beginner-friendly.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Well-defined deliverable: false-positive rate comparison table across detectors. 200 prompts through 4 detectors is manageable. Clear single experiment. Fits comfortably in 30 hours.
